Item.Name: SCAN_UNIT_ID
Item.Hint: Scan unit ID else enter M for manual entry.

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
--HCL s_unit_id char(15);
--HCL s_unit_id varchar2(16); 
 dummy_x VARCHAR2(14);
begin
 default_value('N','GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme'); --HCL
 default_value('D','GLOBAL.checkin_type'); --HCL
 execute_trigger('validate_field'); --HCL 
 check_package_failure; --HCL
--
--HCL s_unit_id := :scan_unit_id;
--HCL :scan_unit_id := null;
--
 :global.dest_fld1 := 'control_block.unit_id';
 :global.next_fld1 := 'control_block.unit_id';
 :global.scan_field := 'units.scan_unit_id';
 :global.checkin_type := 'D';
--
--HCL if s_unit_id = 'M'
--HCL then
--HCL GO_ITEM('unit_id');
--HCL return;
--HCL else
--HCL validate_unit_id_coexist(s_unit_id,'S',:global.codabar_unit_scheme,dummy_x);
-- Check if unit already exists.
--HCL do_key('next_field');
--HCL end if;
--
 IF :scan_unit_id = 'M' --HCL
 THEN --HCL
 :control_block.unit_id := ''; --HCL
 :control_block.coll_date := ''; --HCL
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := ''; --HCL
 :GLOBAL.field_left := 'control_block.unit_id'; --HCL
 go_block('manual_unit_entry_coexist'); --HCL
 ELSE --HCL
 next_item; --HCL
 execute_trigger('key-next-item'); --HCL 
 END IF; --HCL
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* THIS TRIGGER HAS BEEN CREATED BY HCL */

DECLARE
 temp_unit varchar2(15);
BEGIN
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 IF :scan_unit_id != 'M'
 THEN
 validate_unit_id_coexist(:scan_unit_id,'S','*',temp_unit);
 check_package_failure;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_unit;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: PRE-TEXT-ITEM

BEGIN

 THEN

 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 begin
 :coll_date := null;
 select max(coll_date) into :coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :control_block.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 clear_item;
 GO_ITEM('scan_unit_id');
 show_error('1230');
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 end;
 --
 begin
 :system.message_level := 5;
 go_block('donor_tested_units');
 execute_query;

 if :utrs.test_id is null and
 :unit_test_base.test_id is null and
 :donor_tested_units.test_id is null
 then

 end if;
 end;
 end;

Block.Name: UTRS
Block.WhereClause: where unit_id = :control_block.unit_id and nvl(chapter_id,:chapter_id) = :chapter_id and nvl(coll_date,nvl(:coll_date,sysdate)) = nvl(:coll_date,sysdate) and cancel_flag is null and test_id in (select test_id from valid_tests where test_id = utrs.test_id and ((test_group in ('AG','RHBAT','MAG','ROUAG')) or (test_group not in ('AG','ROUAG','RHBAT','MAG') and test_id in ('ABORH','CMV','DAT'))))

Trigger.Name: POST-CHANGE
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 :utrs.src := 'Sched';
 select substr(code_desc,1,15)
 into :utrs.result_desc
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'RESUL'
 and code = :utrs.result_status_1;
exception
 when others
 then null;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
v_local_time date; 
begin

 --
 if :utrs.result_dats is not null then
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :utrs.result_dats,v_local_time);
 :utrs.result_dats:= v_local_time;
 end if;
 end if;
 
 
end;

Block.Name: DONOR_TESTED_UNITS
Block.WhereClause: where unit_id = :control_block.unit_id and nvl(chapter_id,:chapter_id) = :chapter_id and nvl(coll_date,nvl(:coll_date,sysdate)) = nvl(:coll_date,sysdate) and test_id in (select test_id from valid_tests where test_id = donor_tested_units.test_id and ((test_group in ('AG','RHBAT','ROUAG','MAG')) or (test_group not in ('AG','RHBAT','ROUAG','MAG') and test_id in ('ABORH','CMV','DAT'))))

Trigger.Name: POST-CHANGE
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 :donor_tested_units.src := 'Donor';
 select substr(code_desc,1,15) into :donor_tested_units.result_desc
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'RESUL'
 and code = :donor_tested_units.result_status;
exception
 when others
 then null;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
v_local_time date; 
nCount NUMBER:=0;
begin

 --
 if :donor_tested_units.insert_dats is not null then
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :donor_tested_units.insert_dats,v_local_time);
 :donor_tested_units.insert_dats:= v_local_time;
 end if;
 end if;
 
 select nvl(count(*),0) into nCOunt from ag_donor_tests_hdr where donor_id in (select donor_id from donations where unit_id=:donor_tested_units.unit_id) and
 antigen_code=:donor_tested_units.test_id and nvl(confirm_flag,' ')='Y' ;
 
 If nCount > 0 then
 :donor_tested_units.dummy1:='Y';
 End if;
 
exception when others then 
 null; 
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-DOWN
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :system.cursor_block = 'CONTROL_BLOCK'
 then
 show_error('1180');
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
 then
 null;
 else
 down;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-EXIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :system.cursor_block = 'CONTROL_BLOCK'
 OR :global.from_screen = 'CPQUNIT4'
 then
 exit_form(no_validate);
 else
 go_block('utrs');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_block('unit_test_base');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_block('donor_tested_units');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_block('control_block');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 :chapter_id := :global.chapter_id;
 end if;
end;
